title: Scan a Receipt to PDF on iPhone Without Cutting Off the Total
description: To scan a receipt into a useful PDF, capture the whole sheet and check the merchant, date, line items and total before saving.
direct: Leave room around every edge before saving a receipt scan. Open the PDF and zoom in to check the merchant, date and total.
figureAlt: A fully visible fictional receipt rests beside a phone on a dark desk; the total remains unobscured.

cards.choice.heading: Start with the decision
cards.choice.body: Lay the receipt on a flat, contrasting surface with even light. Smooth a curled edge gently and keep fingers and hard shadows away from the text. If the paper is faded, preserve the best original capture rather than expecting compression to reconstruct it.
sections.detail-0.heading: Capture comes before compression
sections.detail-0.body: A sharp capture gives later compression more to work with. Avoid reducing the file until the total and fine text are readable. If the destination needs a smaller PDF, make a separate compressed copy and inspect it again. A photographic PDF is not automatically searchable text or a verified expense record.
sections.detail-1.heading: What the app supports
sections.detail-1.body: Its public listing includes Scan to PDF, compression, signing and sharing. Any export tool can be tried once free; further exports require Pro. Apple also documents scanning in Notes and Files as built-in alternatives. No OCR or automatic receipt-data extraction is claimed for our app.
faqs.reader-question-1.heading: What if the total is readable in preview but cut off in the PDF?
faqs.reader-question-1.body: Check the exported page edges. Rescan with more space around the receipt and inspect the saved result again.
faqs.reader-question-2.heading: What if the receipt is too long to fit clearly in one frame?
faqs.reader-question-2.body: Ask whether the recipient accepts multiple pages. If so, keep an overlap where the sections meet and check that date, items and total remain easy to match.

steps.step-1.text: Open Scan to PDF in PDF Compressor: Sign & Merge and frame the receipt with all edges visible.
steps.step-2.text: Review the captured page before saving. If the bottom, date or an item is cut off or blurred, capture it again. Use the available review controls without assuming a particular crop interface.
steps.step-3.text: Save the PDF, reopen it and zoom in on the smallest important text. Check the actual file before uploading it to an expense or reimbursement system.
